verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers only ROCm/AI-ML software support and generic driver features (Anti-Lag, FSR, Smart Access Memory), with no data on actual gaming frame rates, 4K resolution benchmarks, or independent game benchmark corroboration. This axis clearly applies to a gaming GPU, but no evidence addresses it. Missing for 10: vendor performance claims for 4K/high-refresh gaming, independent benchmark results, any FPS or resolution-specific data.
